snippet.title: Ex Sanguis - TactiCon Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game and join our playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275050/Ex_Sanguis/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcementteaser

Ex Sanguis is a strategy game with dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

Follow us on social media
